_comment: Reviewed display corrections for contract_activity_2026.json. The log itself is never edited here (a data repair needs Keith's go).
Front Office -> Activity shows each listed row under `label` and files it under `activity_type` in the type filter.
A row is corrected only when activity_id, franchise_id and player_id all match. Add a row only with its evidence and the ruling that approved it.

rows.label: Contract change (logged as FA Contract)
rows.evidence: Commissioner-key /commish-contract-update with no submission_kind (salary_change_log 1701, status 200), which the worker labels FA Contract by default. MFL daily snapshots: C-Town Chivalry Smith-Njigba Vet-Ext2-FL $14,000 / 3 years left on 2026-07-26 and 07-27, $1,000 / 2 years left on 07-28 and 07-29 (same contract text). A real change to an existing contract (acquired by trade in 2024), not a free-agent contract.
rows.ruling: Keith 2026-10-28, ruling 7: keep the real change visible; fix the misleading FA Contract label separately.
